LatentView Analytics to announce Q2FY27 results on October 31st, 2026;  
Earnings call to be held on November 2nd, 2026, at 9:00 AM (IST)  
 
Chennai, 16th October 2026 – Latent View Analytics Limited (BSE: 543398, NSE: LATENTVIEW), 
an AI-driven analytics, data engineering, and consulting firm, will announce its Second quarter 
and Half year of FY27 results on Saturday, October 31st, 2026. The earnings call for the 
results would be held on Monday, November 2nd, 2026 at 9:00 AM (IST). The results will also 
be available on the company’s website, https://www.latentview.com. 
 
The details of the Earnings Conference Call are: 
 
Date: November 2nd, 2026  
 
Time (IST): 9:00 AM – 10:00 AM 
 
Universal Access: +91 22 6280 1107 / 7115 8008  
 
International Toll-Free Numbers:  
 
USA – 1 866 746 2133 
UK – 0 808 101 1573 
Singapore – 800 101 2045  
Hong Kong – 800 964 448 
 
Click Here to join with DiamondPass™ (No Wait Time) 
 
Management Representation  
 
Ms. Sonal Ramrakhiani, Chief Executive Officer  
Mr. Rajan Sethuraman, Strategic Advisor to the CEO 
Mr. Rajan Bala Venkatesan, Chief Financial Officer 
 
Participants are requested to dial-in 10 minutes before the scheduled time. 
 
About LatentView Analytics  
Latent View Analytics Limited (LatentView Analytics) is a global data analytics company 
that inspires and transforms businesses to excel in the digital world by harnessing the 
Latent View Analytics Limited 
Q2FY27 Earnings Call Invite  

 
 
 
power of data. The Company provides a 360-degree view of the digital consumer, 
enabling companies to predict new revenue streams, anticipate product trends and 
popularity, improve customer retention rates and optimize investment decisions. 
LatentView Analytics is a trusted partner to enterprises worldwide, including 40+ Fortune 
500 companies in the Technology, Financial services, CPG, Retail, and Healthcare sectors. 
LatentView Analytics partners with clients across the United States, Germany, UK, 
Netherlands, Singapore, Chile, Mexico, India and has over 1750+ employees. For more 
information, please visit https://www.latentview.com/ or follow us on LinkedIn.
